tldr: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 pricing on Jul 30 (Terra -20%, Luna -80%), citing Sol's efficiency gains, with a same-week analysis pegging GPT-5.4-level intelligence as 13x cheaper than four months earlier. On Aug 6 OpenAI followed up with a quality update to Sol and opened unlimited free-tier access to Luna.
whats_new: OpenAI published a builder's guide on Aug 13 covering how startups should split work across GPT-5.6 Terra, Sol, and Luna and use new Responses API capabilities to cut agent costs.
why_it_matters: The guide turns the Jul 30 price cut into concrete model-selection and Responses API patterns for agent pipelines — check it against your own tiering before assuming your current Terra/Sol/Luna split is still the cheapest one that clears your quality bar.

status.state: Price cuts followed by free-tier expansion
status.detail: A Jul 30 price cut (Terra -20%, Luna -80%) attributed to distillation-driven efficiency gains was followed a week later by a Sol quality update and unlimited free access to Luna; OpenAI has since published official guidance on applying the new tiers and Responses API to agent builds.

beats.headline: OpenAI slashes GPT-5.6 pricing — Luna down 80%
beats.summary: Terra gets a 20% price cut and Luna an 80% cut, with OpenAI crediting GPT-5.6 Sol's efficiency gains for enabling the drop.

beats.headline: Recursive self-optimization cuts GPT-5.4-level intelligence cost 13x in four months
beats.summary: A Latent Space AINews roundup frames the price cut as distillation-driven: the cost of matching GPT-5.4 intelligence fell 13x over four months.

beats.headline: Sol gets a quality update, Luna opens up to free users with unlimited chats
beats.summary: OpenAI improves GPT-5.6 Sol's accuracy and consistency in ChatGPT and expands GPT-5.6 Luna access to free users with unlimited everyday chats.

beats.headline: OpenAI publishes a builder's guide to GPT-5.6 model selection and the Responses API
beats.summary: The guide shows startups how to pick among Terra, Sol, and Luna and use new Responses API capabilities to build faster, cheaper agents.

open_questions: Does the 13x cost drop in four months continue at the same pace, or was this a one-time distillation gain from Sol?
Does unlimited free access to Luna hold up under load, or does OpenAI reintroduce rate limits once usage grows?
What exactly are the "new Responses API capabilities" the builder's guide references, and do they require a client/API version upgrade to use?
take_for_builders: Read OpenAI's builder's guide before your next model-selection pass — it lays out concrete Terra/Sol/Luna tiering and Responses API patterns that may replace an ad hoc model pick in your agent pipeline; re-verify any switch against your own eval.
